summary: This video serves as a monthly reminder that creator codes have reset in the game shop. Players can navigate to Store > Treasure Market > Monthly to enter code 'liveranov' and claim the free Support Creator Pack. If the code was previously active, players need to cancel support and re-enter it to rebind for the current month. The creator also highlights discounts on Dragon Crystals and packs via the BuffBuff top-up store.
tips: Navigate to Store > Treasure Market > Monthly tab at the start of each month to enter or re-enter a creator code.
If a creator code is already linked, click 'Cancel Support', confirm, and re-enter the code so it counts for the new month.
Remember to claim the free Support Creator Pack 1 once a creator code is active.
title: Creator Code RESET! Enter liveranov Again + BuffBuff Deals up to 32% OFF | Dragonheir: Silent Gods
